findings.finding: V4 addresses the preserved failure directly: belief intensity no longer shares one undifferentiated role label with action choice, and a proposal action can be represented separately from willingness to accept its outcome.

Gemini identifies stance objects, expression kinds, and source-faithful paraphrases. The prompt defines decision as a chosen course rather than belief intensity and treats reported third-party positions as non-endorsement.

Code enforces shape, bounded role counts, enums, exact duplicates, parent-role evidence subsets, hashes, and terminal custody. It does not infer object or expression correctness or enforce semantic pair compatibility.

A single temporal-role component array reduced the maximum response schema from the first draft's 6,941 bytes to 3,919 bytes. No oneOf, conditional polymorphism, or repeated component schema was added.
All 60 prompts build, all 20 reviewed fixtures compile with zero quarantine, and all non-position prompts and schemas remain byte-identical to v2.
A belief object mislabeled decision is admitted structurally and remains visibly wrong for source review, proving that no brittle semantic compatibility gate was introduced.

The interface follows current official Gemini/OpenRouter guidance: shallow bounded types, descriptions, enums, strict output, application validation, required parameter support, disabled fallback, and preserved semantic-error handling.
Case-04 is the sole unused position-reader case after completed Case-01, Case-02, Case-03, and Case-05 probes are excluded. Selection was mechanical and recorded before the call.
No evaluator, embedding, graph, global synthesis, runtime behavior, semantic retry, response healing, or completed-case repair is introduced.

required_source_review_after_probe: starting components report the team landscape without inventing user endorsement
current components preserve leaning toward the preview and separate the later beta-decision procedure
qualification preserves the practical limit that downloaded public use cannot be made temporary by a label
object and expression labels match each cited source without force inflation
trajectory does not promote the leaning into decision or commitment
every component alias remains inside its parent role and every admitted claim is checked against source
nonclaims: Provider-free conformance is not model-behavior evidence.
One fresh position probe cannot establish stability, transfer, product value, receipt quality, or trust.
Component labels do not create a quality score or prove semantic correctness.
Case-04 is a same-session synthetic development case, not independent gold.
